items.name: gpu-unlock
items.description: Your GeForce runs AI at half speed. This fixes it for 20/30/40 series cards. Up to 2× FP16 / BF16 / TF32 tensor throughput

items.name: MacNativeGames
items.description: Play your own Tears of the Kingdom and Breath of the Wild natively on Apple silicon Mac, iPhone and iPad. Not an emulator: the game's ARM64 code runs directly, NVN rebuilt on Metal. Bring your own game.

items.name: totk-pc-recomp
items.description: Static recompilation of The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom to native Windows and Linux x86-64, with a Vulkan renderer. Game files not included.

items.name: d2r-mobile
items.description: Open-source compatibility layer for Diablo II: Resurrected with the Reign of the Warlock expansion. Runs your own Switch copy natively on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Android and HarmonyOS — full touch controls, 60 fps, new endgame modes. Bring your own game files. 开源的《暗黑破坏神 II：狱火重生》术士君临 iOS / macOS / 安卓 / 鸿蒙兼容层

items.name: gpu-unlock-ada
items.description: GPU tensor unlock source for RTX 4090 and experimental RTX 4070 Ti SUPER; firmware generated locally

items.name: SavageWindRecomp
items.description: Work-in-progress static recompilation of The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild (Switch, v1.9.0) for Windows and Linux. Bring your own dump: no game files, keys or dumping tools included.
